title: एकोनचत्वारिंशत्तमोऽध्यायः
titleEn: Adhyaya 39 · Man as a puppet of fate

summary.en: Dhritarashtra says that man is like a wooden puppet moved by the creator, and asks Vidura to go on. Vidura speaks of friendship, of whom not to befriend, of the value of gentle speech and of treating all one's sons equally, and urges him once more to treat the Pandavas as his own.
summary.kn: ಮನುಷ್ಯನು ಸೃಷ್ಟಿಕರ್ತನು ಆಡಿಸುವ ಮರದ ಗೊಂಬೆಯಂತೆ ಎಂದು ಹೇಳಿ ಧೃತರಾಷ್ಟ್ರನು ವಿದುರನನ್ನು ಮುಂದುವರಿಸೆನ್ನುತ್ತಾನೆ. ಮೈತ್ರಿ, ಯಾರೊಂದಿಗೆ ಸ್ನೇಹ ಮಾಡಬಾರದು, ಮೃದುವಾಕ್ಯದ ಮಹತ್ವ, ಎಲ್ಲ ಮಕ್ಕಳನ್ನೂ ಸಮನಾಗಿ ಕಾಣುವುದರ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ವಿದುರನು ಹೇಳಿ, ಪಾಂಡವರನ್ನು ಸ್ವಂತ ಮಕ್ಕಳಂತೆ ಕಾಣೆಂದು ಮತ್ತೊಮ್ಮೆ ಒತ್ತಾಯಿಸುತ್ತಾನೆ.
summary.hi: धृतराष्ट्र कहते हैं कि मनुष्य विधाता द्वारा नचाई जाने वाली कठपुतली जैसा है, और विदुर से आगे कहने को कहते हैं। विदुर मैत्री, किससे मित्रता न करें, कोमल वाणी के मूल्य और सब पुत्रों से समान व्यवहार की बात करते हैं, और फिर आग्रह करते हैं कि वे पाण्डवों को अपना मानें।
summary.te: మనిషి సృష్టికర్త ఆడించే చెక్కబొమ్మ వంటివాడని చెప్పి ధృతరాష్ట్రుడు విదురుని కొనసాగించమంటాడు. మైత్రి, ఎవరితో స్నేహం చేయకూడదు, మృదువైన మాట విలువ, కుమారులందరినీ సమానంగా చూడడం గురించి విదురుడు చెప్పి, పాండవులను తన సొంతవారిగా చూడమని మరోసారి కోరతాడు.
summary.ta: மனிதன் படைப்பவனால் ஆட்டுவிக்கப்படும் மரப்பாவை போன்றவன் என்று சொல்லி த்ருதராஷ்டிரன் விதுரரைத் தொடருமாறு கேட்கிறான். நட்பு, யாருடன் நட்புக் கொள்ளக் கூடாது, இனிய சொல்லின் மதிப்பு, எல்லா மைந்தர்களையும் சமமாக நடத்துவது பற்றி விதுரர் பேசி, பாண்டவர்களைத் தன் சொந்தமாக நடத்துமாறு மீண்டும் வற்புறுத்துகிறார்.
summary.ml: മനുഷ്യൻ ദൈവം ചലിപ്പിക്കുന്ന മരപ്പാവപോലെയാണെന്ന് ധൃതരാഷ്ട്രർ പറയുന്നു; വിദുരർ തുടരാൻ അദ്ദേഹം ആവശ്യപ്പെടുന്നു. സൗഹൃദത്തെക്കുറിച്ചും ആരെ സുഹൃത്താക്കിക്കൂടാ എന്നതിനെക്കുറിച്ചും, മൃദുവായ വാക്കിന്റെ മൂല്യത്തെക്കുറിച്ചും, എല്ലാ മക്കളെയും തുല്യമായി കാണുന്നതിനെക്കുറിച്ചും വിദുരർ സംസാരിക്കുന്നു; പാണ്ഡവരെ സ്വന്തം മക്കളെപ്പോലെ കാണാൻ അദ്ദേഹം ഒരിക്കൽക്കൂടി ഉപദേശിക്കുന്നു.

source: Mahabharata, Critical Edition (BORI, Pune) 5.39; e-text by M. Tokunaga and J. D. Smith, © BORI 1999, version of Tue Jan 23 2024

verses.text: धृतराष्ट्र उवाच

meaning.en: Dhritarashtra said:

verses.text:
अनीश्वरोऽयं पुरुषो भवाभवे
सूत्रप्रोता दारुमयीव योषा ।
धात्रा तु दिष्टस्य वशे किलायं
तस्माद्वद त्वं श्रवणे धृतोऽहम् ॥

meaning.en: This man has no control over being and not being; like a wooden woman strung on threads, he is surely under the power of what the Creator ordained. So tell me; I am attentive to hear.

verses.text: विदुर उवाच

meaning.en: Vidura said:

verses.text:
अप्राप्तकालं वचनं बृहस्पतिरपि ब्रुवन् ।
लभते बुद्ध्यवज्ञानमवमानं च भारत ॥

meaning.en: Even Brihaspati, speaking words out of season, meets contempt and insult for his wisdom, Bharata.

verses.text:
प्रियो भवति दानेन प्रियवादेन चापरः ।
मन्त्रं मूलबलेनान्यो यः प्रियः प्रिय एव सः ॥

meaning.en: One becomes dear by giving, another by pleasant speech, another by charm and spells; but he who is dear is simply dear.

verses.text:
द्वेष्यो न साधुर्भवति न मेधावी न पण्डितः ।
प्रिये शुभानि कर्माणि द्वेष्ये पापानि भारत ॥

meaning.en: One who is disliked is not seen as good, nor wise, nor learned; to the dear one go good deeds, to the disliked bad ones, Bharata.

verses.text:
न स क्षयो महाराज यः क्षयो वृद्धिमावहेत् ।
क्षयः स त्विह मन्तव्यो यं लब्ध्वा बहु नाशयेत् ॥

meaning.en: That is not a loss, great king, which brings gain; one should regard that as loss which, once gotten, destroys much.

verses.text:
समृद्धा गुणतः केचिद्भवन्ति धनतोऽपरे ।
धनवृद्धान्गुणैर्हीनान्धृतराष्ट्र विवर्जयेत् ॥

meaning.en: Some are rich in qualities, others in wealth; Dhritarashtra, avoid those who are rich in wealth but lacking in qualities.

verses.text: धृतराष्ट्र उवाच

meaning.en: Dhritarashtra said:

verses.text:
सर्वं त्वमायतीयुक्तं भाषसे प्राज्ञसंमतम् ।
न चोत्सहे सुतं त्यक्तुं यतो धर्मस्ततो जयः ॥

meaning.en: You say everything bearing on the future, as the wise approve; but I cannot bring myself to abandon my son, since where dharma is, there is victory.

verses.text: विदुर उवाच

meaning.en: Vidura said:

verses.text:
स्वभावगुणसंपन्नो न जातु विनयान्वितः ।
सुसूक्ष्ममपि भूतानामुपमर्दं प्रयोक्ष्यते ॥

meaning.en: A man endowed with a natural bent for harm, never with humility, will inflict even the tiniest injury on creatures.

verses.text:
परापवादनिरताः परदुःखोदयेषु च ।
परस्परविरोधे च यतन्ते सततोत्थिताः ॥

meaning.en: They delight in slandering others and in the growth of others' misery, and they work ever alert to set one against another.

verses.text:
सदोषं दर्शनं येषां संवासे सुमहद्भयम् ।
अर्थादाने महान्दोषः प्रदाने च महद्भयम् ॥

meaning.en: Those whose very look is faulty, living with them is a great danger; in taking wealth from them there is great fault, and in giving there is great fear.

verses.text:
ये पापा इति विख्याताः संवासे परिगर्हिताः ।
युक्ताश्चान्यैर्महादोषैर्ये नरास्तान्विवर्जयेत् ॥

meaning.en: Those who are known as sinners, condemned in company, and joined with other great faults, one should avoid.

verses.text:
निवर्तमाने सौहार्दे प्रीतिर्नीचे प्रणश्यति ।
या चैव फलनिर्वृत्तिः सौहृदे चैव यत्सुखम् ॥

meaning.en: When goodwill ends, the friendship of a base man vanishes, as does the fruit it bore and the pleasure of friendship.

verses.text:
यतते चापवादाय यत्नमारभते क्षये ।
अल्पेऽप्यपकृते मोहान्न शान्तिमुपगच्छति ॥

meaning.en: He strives for slander and starts effort at ruin; even for a small wrong he does not, out of folly, come to peace.

verses.text:
तादृशैः संगतं नीचैर्नृशंसैरकृतात्मभिः ।
निशाम्य निपुणं बुद्ध्या विद्वान्दूराद्विवर्जयेत् ॥

meaning.en: A learned man, having observed with his mind carefully, should keep far from association with such base, cruel, uncultivated men.

verses.text:
यो ज्ञातिमनुगृह्णाति दरिद्रं दीनमातुरम् ।
स पुत्रपशुभिर्वृद्धिं यशश्चाव्ययमश्नुते ॥

meaning.en: He who helps a kinsman who is poor, wretched or sick gains growth in sons and cattle, and lasting fame.

verses.text:
ज्ञातयो वर्धनीयास्तैर्य इच्छन्त्यात्मनः शुभम् ।
कुलवृद्धिं च राजेन्द्र तस्मात्साधु समाचर ॥

meaning.en: Kinsmen should be raised up by those who wish their own good and the growth of their family, king of kings; so act well.

verses.text:
श्रेयसा योक्ष्यसे राजन्कुर्वाणो ज्ञातिसत्क्रियाम् ।
विगुणा ह्यपि संरक्ष्या ज्ञातयो भरतर्षभ ॥

meaning.en: You will be united with the highest good, king, by honoring your kinsmen; even those lacking in virtues are to be protected, bull of the Bharatas.

verses.text:
किं पुनर्गुणवन्तस्ते त्वत्प्रसादाभिकाङ्क्षिणः ।
प्रसादं कुरु दीनानां पाण्डवानां विशां पते ॥

meaning.en: How much more those who are virtuous and who long for your favor? Show favor to the Pandavas, who are in distress, lord of the people.

verses.text:
दीयन्तां ग्रामकाः केचित्तेषां वृत्त्यर्थमीश्वर ।
एवं लोके यशःप्राप्तो भविष्यसि नराधिप ॥

meaning.en: Let some villages be given to them for their livelihood, lord; thus you will gain fame in the world, king of men.

verses.text:
वृद्धेन हि त्वया कार्यं पुत्राणां तात रक्षणम् ।
मया चापि हितं वाच्यं विद्धि मां त्वद्धितैषिणम् ॥

meaning.en: You, dear friend, being old, must protect your sons, and I must tell you what is good; know that I wish you well.

verses.text:
ज्ञातिभिर्विग्रहस्तात न कर्तव्यो भवार्थिना ।
सुखानि सह भोज्यानि ज्ञातिभिर्भरतर्षभ ॥

meaning.en: One who desires prosperity should not fight with kinsmen, dear friend; one should enjoy happiness together with kinsmen, bull of the Bharatas.

verses.text:
संभोजनं संकथनं संप्रीतिश्च परस्परम् ।
ज्ञातिभिः सह कार्याणि न विरोधः कथंचन ॥

meaning.en: Eating together, conversation and mutual affection are what should be done with kinsmen; never opposition.

verses.text:
ज्ञातयस्तारयन्तीह ज्ञातयो मज्जयन्ति च ।
सुवृत्तास्तारयन्तीह दुर्वृत्ता मज्जयन्ति च ॥

meaning.en: Kinsmen save here, and kinsmen drown; those of good conduct save, those of bad conduct drown.

verses.text:
सुवृत्तो भव राजेन्द्र पाण्डवान्प्रति मानद ।
अधर्षणीयः शत्रूणां तैर्वृतस्त्वं भविष्यसि ॥

meaning.en: Be of good conduct toward the Pandavas, giver of honor; surrounded by them you will be unassailable by enemies.

verses.text:
श्रीमन्तं ज्ञातिमासाद्य यो ज्ञातिरवसीदति ।
दिग्धहस्तं मृग इव स एनस्तस्य विन्दति ॥

meaning.en: A kinsman who is languishing when he has gone to a prosperous kinsman is like a deer to one with poisoned hands; he gets the sin.

verses.text:
पश्चादपि नरश्रेष्ठ तव तापो भविष्यति ।
तान्वा हतान्सुतान्वापि श्रुत्वा तदनुचिन्तय ॥

meaning.en: Afterward too, best of men, you will be tormented; hearing that they or your sons are slain, think on this.

verses.text:
येन खट्वां समारूढः परितप्येत कर्मणा ।
आदावेव न तत्कुर्यादध्रुवे जीविते सति ॥

meaning.en: One should not do in the first place a deed by which one, lying on his deathbed, would be tormented, since life is uncertain.

verses.text:
न कश्चिन्नापनयते पुमानन्यत्र भार्गवात् ।
शेषसंप्रतिपत्तिस्तु बुद्धिमत्स्वेव तिष्ठति ॥

meaning.en: There is no man who does no wrong except Bhargava; but receiving the rest is found only among the wise.

verses.text:
दुर्योधनेन यद्येतत्पापं तेषु पुरा कृतम् ।
त्वया तत्कुलवृद्धेन प्रत्यानेयं नरेश्वर ॥

meaning.en: If Duryodhana did this wrong to them earlier, you, as the head of the family, should repair it, lord of men.

verses.text:
तांस्त्वं पदे प्रतिष्ठाप्य लोके विगतकल्मषः ।
भविष्यसि नरश्रेष्ठ पूजनीयो मनीषिणाम् ॥

meaning.en: Having re-established them in their place, you will be free from sin in the world and become honored by the wise, best of men.

verses.text:
सुव्याहृतानि धीराणां फलतः प्रविचिन्त्य यः ।
अध्यवस्यति कार्येषु चिरं यशसि तिष्ठति ॥

meaning.en: He who, having weighed the well-spoken words of the steadfast by their results, resolves his tasks, stays long in fame.

verses.text:
अवृत्तिं विनयो हन्ति हन्त्यनर्थं पराक्रमः ।
हन्ति नित्यं क्षमा क्रोधमाचारो हन्त्यलक्षणम् ॥

meaning.en: Humility kills lack of livelihood, valor kills harm, patience always kills anger, and good conduct kills ill omen.

verses.text:
परिच्छदेन क्षेत्रेण वेश्मना परिचर्यया ।
परीक्षेत कुलं राजन्भोजनाच्छादनेन च ॥

meaning.en: One should examine a family by its household things, field, house, service, and by its food and clothing, king.

verses.text:
ययोश्चित्तेन वा चित्तं नैभृतं नैभृतेन वा ।
समेति प्रज्ञया प्रज्ञा तयोर्मैत्री न जीर्यते ॥

meaning.en: Those whose hearts agree with heart, hidden with hidden, or wisdom with wisdom, their friendship does not age.

verses.text:
दुर्बुद्धिमकृतप्रज्ञं छन्नं कूपं तृणैरिव ।
विवर्जयीत मेधावी तस्मिन्मैत्री प्रणश्यति ॥

meaning.en: Avoid the ill-minded, the uncultured, like a well covered with grass; with him friendship is lost.

verses.text:
अवलिप्तेषु मूर्खेषु रौद्रसाहसिकेषु च ।
तथैवापेतधर्मेषु न मैत्रीमाचरेद्बुधः ॥

meaning.en: The wise man should not make friendship with the arrogant, the foolish, the fierce and rash, and those who have left dharma.

verses.text:
कृतज्ञं धार्मिकं सत्यमक्षुद्रं दृढभक्तिकम् ।
जितेन्द्रियं स्थितं स्थित्यां मित्रमत्यागि चेष्यते ॥

meaning.en: A friend is wanted who is grateful, righteous, truthful, not petty, firm in devotion, master of his senses, steady in his position, and who does not forsake.

verses.text:
इन्द्रियाणामनुत्सर्गो मृत्युना न विशिष्यते ।
अत्यर्थं पुनरुत्सर्गः सादयेद्दैवतान्यपि ॥

meaning.en: Not restraining the senses is no different from death; and going too far in letting them loose would ruin even the gods.

verses.text:
मार्दवं सर्वभूतानामनसूया क्षमा धृतिः ।
आयुष्याणि बुधाः प्राहुर्मित्राणां चाविमानना ॥

meaning.en: Gentleness toward all beings, freedom from envy, patience and steadiness, the wise say, are life-giving; so is not despising friends.

verses.text:
अपनीतं सुनीतेन योऽर्थं प्रत्यानिनीषते ।
मतिमास्थाय सुदृढां तदकापुरुषव्रतम् ॥

meaning.en: He who, relying on a firm resolve, wishes to recover a thing lost by good policy through bad, such a vow is a coward's.

verses.text:
आयत्यां प्रतिकारज्ञस्तदात्वे दृढनिश्चयः ।
अतीते कार्यशेषज्ञो नरोऽर्थैर्न प्रहीयते ॥

meaning.en: He who knows the remedy for the future, is firm in resolve in the present, and knows what remains to be done from the past, is not deprived of his aims.

verses.text:
कर्मणा मनसा वाचा यदभीक्ष्णं निषेवते ।
तदेवापहरत्येनं तस्मात्कल्याणमाचरेत् ॥

meaning.en: What one constantly practices by deed, mind and speech, that carries him off; therefore one should practice good.

verses.text:
मङ्गलालम्भनं योगः श्रुतमुत्थानमार्जवम् ।
भूतिमेतानि कुर्वन्ति सतां चाभीक्ष्णदर्शनम् ॥

meaning.en: Seeking auspicious things, discipline, learning, effort, honesty, and frequent sight of the good bring prosperity.

verses.text:
अनिर्वेदः श्रियो मूलं दुःखनाशे सुखस्य च ।
महान्भवत्यनिर्विण्णः सुखं चात्यन्तमश्नुते ॥

meaning.en: Freedom from despair is the root of prosperity, of the end of sorrow and of happiness; the undespairing man becomes great and gains happiness without limit.

verses.text:
नातः श्रीमत्तरं किंचिदन्यत्पथ्यतमं तथा ।
प्रभविष्णोर्यथा तात क्षमा सर्वत्र सर्वदा ॥

meaning.en: There is nothing more prosperous or more wholesome than this for a man of power, dear friend: forbearance, everywhere and always.

verses.text:
क्षमेदशक्तः सर्वस्य शक्तिमान्धर्मकारणात् ।
अर्थानर्थौ समौ यस्य तस्य नित्यं क्षमा हिता ॥

meaning.en: The powerless should forgive everyone, and the powerful should, for dharma's sake; for him to whom gain and loss are the same, forgiveness is always good.

verses.text:
यत्सुखं सेवमानोऽपि धर्मार्थाभ्यां न हीयते ।
कामं तदुपसेवेत न मूढव्रतमाचरेत् ॥

meaning.en: The pleasure by which one, even enjoying it, is not deprived of dharma and wealth, one may pursue as one likes, but not practice the fool's vow.

verses.text:
दुःखार्तेषु प्रमत्तेषु नास्तिकेष्वलसेषु च ।
न श्रीर्वसत्यदान्तेषु ये चोत्साहविवर्जिताः ॥

meaning.en: Prosperity does not live with those afflicted by sorrow, the careless, the nonbelievers, the lazy, the uncontrolled, and those lacking energy.

verses.text:
आर्जवेन नरं युक्तमार्जवात्सव्यपत्रपम् ।
अशक्तिमन्तं मन्यन्तो धर्षयन्ति कुबुद्धयः ॥

meaning.en: Foolish people attack a man who is straightforward, and out of his honesty, modest, thinking him powerless.

verses.text:
अत्यार्यमतिदातारमतिशूरमतिव्रतम् ।
प्रज्ञाभिमानिनं चैव श्रीर्भयान्नोपसर्पति ॥

meaning.en: Prosperity does not approach, out of fear, one who is too noble, too generous, too brave, too strict in vows, or proud of his wisdom.

verses.text:
अग्निहोत्रफला वेदाः शीलवृत्तफलं श्रुतम् ।
रतिपुत्रफला दारा दत्तभुक्तफलं धनम् ॥

meaning.en: The Vedas bear fruit in the agnihotra, learning in good character and conduct, wives in pleasure and sons, wealth in giving and enjoying.

verses.text:
अधर्मोपार्जितैरर्थैर्यः करोत्यौर्ध्वदेहिकम् ।
न स तस्य फलं प्रेत्य भुङ्क्तेऽर्थस्य दुरागमात् ॥

meaning.en: He who performs rites for the next world with wealth earned unrighteously does not, after death, enjoy the fruit of it, because of the bad way it was gained.

verses.text:
कान्तारवनदुर्गेषु कृच्छ्रास्वापत्सु संभ्रमे ।
उद्यतेषु च शस्त्रेषु नास्ति शेषवतां भयम् ॥

meaning.en: In wilderness, forest, difficult places, hard calamities, panic and when weapons are raised, those who have a remainder have no fear.

verses.text:
उत्थानं संयमो दाक्ष्यमप्रमादो धृतिः स्मृतिः ।
समीक्ष्य च समारम्भो विद्धि मूलं भवस्य तत् ॥

meaning.en: Effort, restraint, skill, carefulness, steadiness, memory, and starting after reflection: know that these are the root of prosperity.

verses.text:
तपो बलं तापसानां ब्रह्म ब्रह्मविदां बलम् ।
हिंसा बलमसाधूनां क्षमा गुणवतां बलम् ॥

meaning.en: Austerity is the strength of ascetics, Brahman the strength of knowers of Brahman, violence the strength of the wicked, and forgiveness the strength of the virtuous.

verses.text:
अष्टौ तान्यव्रतघ्नानि आपो मूलं फलं पयः ।
हविर्ब्राह्मणकाम्या च गुरोर्वचनमौषधम् ॥

meaning.en: Eight things do not break a vow: water, roots, fruit, milk, the oblation, a brahmin's desire, the word of the teacher, and medicine.

verses.text:
न तत्परस्य संदध्यात्प्रतिकूलं यदात्मनः ।
संग्रहेणैष धर्मः स्यात्कामादन्यः प्रवर्तते ॥

meaning.en: Do not do to another what is opposed to yourself; in brief this is dharma, and the rest proceeds from desire.

verses.text:
अक्रोधेन जयेत्क्रोधमसाधुं साधुना जयेत् ।
जयेत्कदर्यं दानेन जयेत्सत्येन चानृतम् ॥

meaning.en: One should conquer anger by freedom from anger, the bad by the good, the miser by giving, and falsehood by truth.

verses.text:
स्त्रीधूर्तकेऽलसे भीरौ चण्डे पुरुषमानिनि ।
चौरे कृतघ्ने विश्वासो न कार्यो न च नास्तिके ॥

meaning.en: Trust should not be placed in a woman, a cheat, a lazy man, a coward, a violent man, one who is proud of his manhood, a thief, an ingrate, or a nonbeliever.

verses.text:
अभिवादनशीलस्य नित्यं वृद्धोपसेविनः ।
चत्वारि संप्रवर्धन्ते कीर्तिरायुर्यशोबलम् ॥

meaning.en: For one who greets constantly and serves the elders, four things grow: fame, life, glory and strength.

verses.text:
अतिक्लेशेन येऽर्थाः स्युर्धर्मस्यातिक्रमेण च ।
अरेर्वा प्रणिपातेन मा स्म तेषु मनः कृथाः ॥

meaning.en: Do not set your mind on gains made with great suffering, by overstepping dharma, or by bowing to an enemy.

verses.text:
अविद्यः पुरुषः शोच्यः शोच्यं मिथुनमप्रजम् ।
निराहाराः प्रजाः शोच्याः शोच्यं राष्ट्रमराजकम् ॥

meaning.en: An uneducated man is to be pitied, a childless couple is to be pitied, people without food are to be pitied, and a kingdom without a king is to be pitied.

verses.text:
अध्वा जरा देहवतां पर्वतानां जलं जरा ।
असंभोगो जरा स्त्रीणां वाक्शल्यं मनसो जरा ॥

meaning.en: Travel is old age for the embodied, water is old age for mountains, lack of enjoyment is old age for women, and a thorn of words is old age for the mind.

verses.text:
अनाम्नायमला वेदा ब्राह्मणस्याव्रतं मलम् ।
कौतूहलमला साध्वी विप्रवासमलाः स्त्रियः ॥

meaning.en: Lack of recitation is the dirt of the Vedas, lack of vows is the dirt of a brahmin, curiosity is the dirt of a good woman, and being away from home is the dirt of women.

verses.text:
सुवर्णस्य मलं रूप्यं रूप्यस्यापि मलं त्रपु ।
ज्ञेयं त्रपुमलं सीसं सीसस्यापि मलं मलम् ॥

meaning.en: Silver is the dirt of gold, tin is the dirt of silver, lead should be known as the dirt of tin, and the dirt of lead is dirt itself.

verses.text:
न स्वप्नेन जयेन्निद्रां न कामेन स्त्रियं जयेत् ।
नेन्धनेन जयेदग्निं न पानेन सुरां जयेत् ॥

meaning.en: One does not conquer sleep by sleeping, nor a woman by desire, nor fire by fuel, nor liquor by drinking.

verses.text:
यस्य दानजितं मित्रममित्रा युधि निर्जिताः ।
अन्नपानजिता दाराः सफलं तस्य जीवितम् ॥

meaning.en: He whose friends are won by giving, whose enemies are defeated in battle, and whose wives are won by food and drink has a fruitful life.

verses.text:
सहस्रिणोऽपि जीवन्ति जीवन्ति शतिनस्तथा ।
धृतराष्ट्रं विमुञ्चेच्छां न कथंचिन्न जीव्यते ॥

meaning.en: Men with thousands live, and men with hundreds live too; Dhritarashtra, give up your wish: there is no way one does not live.

verses.text:
यत्पृथिव्यां व्रीहियवं हिरण्यं पशवः स्त्रियः ।
नालमेकस्य तत्सर्वमिति पश्यन्न मुह्यति ॥

meaning.en: He who sees that all the grain, barley, gold, animals and women on earth are not enough for one man is not confused.

verses.text:
राजन्भूयो ब्रवीमि त्वां पुत्रेषु सममाचर ।
समता यदि ते राजन्स्वेषु पाण्डुसुतेषु च ॥

meaning.en: King, I tell you again: treat your sons equally; if there is equality in you toward your own sons and the sons of Pandu.
